title: faceto event-log line
description: ONE line of a `<name>.event-log.jsonl` — a single event object. The log is the append-only source of truth; the board is a projection replayed from it. Parsed by `events::parse_event`. The schema evolves ADDITIVELY: on read, unknown event kinds are skipped and unknown fields ignored, so old and new logs stay mutually replayable — hence `additionalProperties: true` on every branch. This schema enumerates the CURRENT kinds; a future additive kind will be valid at runtime (skipped) even before it is listed here. When a new `Event` variant is added to `src/events/codec.rs`, add its branch here too.

oneOf.title: BoardLeveled
oneOf.description: Sets modeling granularity. Additive kind — an old log without it replays as the default big-picture.

id.description: Optional — a legacy band with no id gets a deterministic positional id minted on replay.

oneOf.title: FrontierMoved
oneOf.description: Move one border of a phase; replay re-borders the neighbour atomically so the partition never opens a gap.

oneOf.title: PhaseSplit
oneOf.description: Split a phase in two at atCol; `id` keeps the left half, `newId` (server-minted) takes the right.

id.description: Minted server-side (`<PREFIX><N>`) when the add comes through `POST /comment`.

y.description: Sub-position within the lane band; omit for auto-stacking.

oneOf.title: ElementMoved
oneOf.description: Move and/or re-lane a sticky. An absent field leaves that dimension untouched (a col-only nudge never resets y or type).

oneOf.title: ElementAnnotated
oneOf.description: A comment on an element (a first-class event). Legacy kinds `CommentAdded` / `Comment` are upcast to this on read.

resolution.description: Resolution note; may be an empty string.

oneOf.title: ElementRemoved
oneOf.description: Removes the element; replay cascades to drop its edges. The id stays reserved (never reused) until a compaction.

oneOf.title: EdgeAdded
oneOf.description: A directed edge. Note: unlike model.json (tuple `[src, dst]`), edges in the LOG are objects.

oneOf.title: LogCompacted
oneOf.description: A marker written by `faceto compact` recording how many events were folded into the preceding genesis snapshot.

folded.description: Count of folded events; defaults to 0 if absent.

elementType.description: The 8-lane event-storming grammar (lane + colour). An off-grammar value does not crash but has no lane.
